effects.name: 回避
effects.description: 你专注于躲避攻击。直到下一回合开始前，针对你的攻击检定具有劣势（前提是你能看到攻击者），并且你的敏捷豁免检定具有优势。
effects.descriptionEn: Until the start of your next turn, any attack roll made against you has disadvantage if you can see the attacker, and you make Dexterity saving throws with advantage.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
🛡️ **{source}** 采取**回避**动作！
> 直到下回合开始前，对其的攻击检定具有**劣势**，敏捷豁免具有**优势**

effects.name: 疾走
effects.description: 你本回合获得等于你速度的额外移动力。
effects.descriptionEn: You gain extra movement for the current turn. The increase equals your speed.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
💨 **{source}** 采取**疾走**动作！
> 移动力 +{value}尺

effects.name: 撤离
effects.description: 你本回合的移动不会引发借机攻击。
effects.descriptionEn: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of the turn.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
🏃 **{source}** 采取**撤离**动作！
> 本回合移动不引发借机攻击

effects.name: 协助
effects.description: 你协助一名友方生物完成某项任务，或分散敌人注意力。被协助的生物下次攻击检定具有优势。
effects.descriptionEn: You lend your aid to another creature. The aided creature gains advantage on its next attack roll against the target.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
🤝 **{source}** 协助 **{target}**！
> 下次攻击检定具有**优势**

effects.name: 躲藏
effects.description: 你进行隐匿检定尝试躲藏。
effects.descriptionEn: You make a Dexterity (Stealth) check in an attempt to hide.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
👁️ **{source}** 尝试**躲藏**！
> 请进行隐匿（敏捷）检定

effects.name: 躲藏中
effects.description: 你处于隐蔽状态。攻击检定具有优势，针对你的攻击检定具有劣势。攻击后隐蔽状态结束。
effects.descriptionEn: You are hidden. You have advantage on attack rolls. Attack rolls against you have disadvantage. Attacking ends this condition.

effects.name: 预备
effects.description: 你准备在某个触发条件下执行一个动作或移动。
effects.descriptionEn: You prepare to take an action in response to a trigger you define.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
⏳ **{source}** 采取**预备**动作！
> 等待触发条件执行反应

effects.name: 搜索
effects.description: 你花费动作进行感知（侦查）或智力（调查）检定来搜索周围。
effects.descriptionEn: You devote your attention to finding something, making a Perception or Investigation check.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
🔍 **{source}** 采取**搜索**动作！
> 进行感知或调查检定

effects.name: 使用物件
effects.description: 你使用一个物件或与环境中的物件互动。
effects.descriptionEn: You interact with an object or use it in a special way.

actionEffect.chatTemplate: 🎒 **{source}** 采取**使用物件**动作！

effects.name: 即兴动作
effects.description: 你执行一个自由发挥的动作，由DM裁定结果。
effects.descriptionEn: You attempt something not covered by the other actions, as adjudicated by the DM.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
💡 **{source}** 采取**即兴动作**！
> 等待DM裁定

effects.name: 狂暴
effects.description: 作为附赠动作，你进入狂暴状态。狂暴时，你的力量检定和豁免具有优势，近战武器攻击获得额外伤害，并且对钝击、穿刺和挥砍伤害具有抗性。
effects.descriptionEn: As a bonus action, you enter a rage. While raging, you gain advantage on Strength checks and saves, bonus damage on melee attacks, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
🔥 **{source}** 进入**狂暴**状态！
> 力量检定和豁免优势，近战伤害加成，钝击/穿刺/挥砍伤害抗性

effects.name: 鲁莽攻击
effects.description: 当你在本回合进行第一次攻击时，你可以选择鲁莽攻击。这样做会使你本回合的所有力量近战攻击检定具有优势，但直到下一回合开始前，针对你的攻击检定也具有优势。
effects.descriptionEn: When you make your first attack on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly. Doing so gives you advantage on melee weapon attack rolls using Strength during this turn, but attack rolls against you have advantage until your next turn.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
💢 **{source}** 使用**鲁莽攻击**！
> 本回合力量近战攻击具有优势，但被攻击也具有优势

effects.name: 狂乱
effects.description: 你可以在狂暴时进入狂乱状态。狂乱时，你可以用附赠动作进行一次近战武器攻击。狂暴结束后，你获得一级力竭。
effects.descriptionEn: You can go into a frenzy when you rage. While frenzied, you can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action. When your rage ends, you suffer one level of exhaustion.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
😡 **{source}** 进入**狂乱**状态！
> 每回合可用附赠动作进行一次近战武器攻击
> ⚠️ 狂乱结束后将承受1级力竭

action.description: 狂乱结束后获得一级力竭

effects.name: 回气
effects.description: 作为附赠动作，你可以恢复等于1d10+战士等级的生命值。
effects.descriptionEn: As a bonus action, you can regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level.

effects.name: 行动如潮
effects.description: 你可以在本回合获得一个额外的动作。
effects.descriptionEn: You can take one additional action on your turn.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
⚡ **{source}** 使用**行动如潮**！
> 本回合获得一个额外动作

effects.name: 激励
effects.description: 作为附赠动作，你可以给予一名60尺内的生物一颗激励骰。该生物可以在接下来10分钟内的一次攻击检定、属性检定或豁免检定中加上激励骰的结果。
effects.descriptionEn: As a bonus action, you give one creature within 60 feet a Bardic Inspiration die. The creature can add it to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw within the next 10 minutes.

effects.name: 野性形态
effects.description: 作为动作，你可以变形为一只你见过的野兽。
effects.descriptionEn: As an action, you can magically assume the shape of a beast that you have seen before.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
🐺 **{source}** 使用**野性形态**！
> 变形为一只野兽

effects.name: 狡诈动作
effects.description: 从2级起，你可以使用附赠动作进行疾走、撤离或躲藏。
effects.descriptionEn: You can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
🗡️ **{source}** 使用**狡诈动作**！
> 以附赠动作执行疾走、撤离或躲藏

effects.name: 神圣感知
effects.description: 作为动作，你可以感知60尺内任何天界生物、邪魔或不死生物的存在，并感知30尺内被祝圣或亵渎的地点。
effects.descriptionEn: As an action, you can detect good and evil. Until the end of your next turn, you can sense anything affected by the hallow spell or know the location of any celestial, fiend, or undead within 60 feet.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
👁️ **{source}** 使用**神圣感知**！
> 感知60尺内天界生物、邪魔或不死生物的存在

effects.name: 消失无踪
effects.description: 从14级起，你可以使用附赠动作进行躲藏。
effects.descriptionEn: Starting at 14th level, you can use the Hide action as a bonus action on your turn.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
🌿 **{source}** 使用**消失无踪**！
> 以附赠动作进行隐匿检定

effects.name: 心神宁静
effects.description: 从7级起，你可以使用动作结束自身的魅惑或恐惧效果。
effects.descriptionEn: Starting at 7th level, you can use your action to end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be charmed or frightened.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
🧘 **{source}** 使用**心神宁静**！
> 结束自身的魅惑或恐惧效果

effects.name: 反魅惑
effects.description: 从6级起，你可以使用动作进行歌唱或演说，30尺内的盟友在对抗恐惧和魅惑效果的豁免检定中具有优势，持续到你下回合结束。
effects.descriptionEn: At 6th level, you can use musical notes or words of power to disrupt mind-influencing effects. Allies within 30 feet gain advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
🎶 **{source}** 使用**反魅惑**！
> 30尺内盟友对恐惧和魅惑的豁免具有**优势**，持续到下回合结束

effects.name: 忍耐防御
effects.description: 你可以花费1点气，使用附赠动作采取回避动作。
effects.descriptionEn: You can spend 1 ki point to take the Dodge action as a bonus action on your turn.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
🛡️ **{source}** 花费1点气使用**忍耐防御**！
> 本回合采取回避动作，攻击检定对其具有劣势

effects.name: 疾风步
effects.description: 你可以花费1点气，使用附赠动作采取疾走或撤离动作，且跳跃距离翻倍。
effects.descriptionEn: You can spend 1 ki point to take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
💨 **{source}** 花费1点气使用**疾风步**！
> 移动力 +{value}尺，且跳跃距离翻倍

effects.name: 连环拳
effects.description: 你在攻击动作后可以花费1点气，使用附赠动作进行两次徒手打击。
effects.descriptionEn: Immediately after you take the Attack action, you can spend 1 ki point to make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
👊 **{source}** 花费1点气使用**连环拳**！
> 以附赠动作进行两次徒手打击

effects.name: 神圣武器
effects.description: 使用引导神力，你将神圣力量灌注入武器。1分钟内，攻击检定加上魅力修正（至少+1），武器散发明亮光芒。
effects.descriptionEn: As an action, you channel divinity to imbue one weapon with positive energy. For 1 minute, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls (minimum +1). The weapon emits bright light.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
⚔️ **{source}** 引导神力：**神圣武器**！
> 1分钟内攻击检定加上魅力修正，武器散发光芒

effects.name: 圣疗
effects.description: 你拥有一个治疗之池，可以恢复等于圣骑士等级×5的生命值。触摸一个生物，从池中抽取任意量的生命值恢复给它。
effects.descriptionEn: You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you take a long rest. You can restore a number of hit points equal to your paladin level × 5.

effects.name: 奥术恢复
effects.description: 短休时，你可以恢复已消耗的法术位，恢复的法术位总等级不超过你法师等级的一半（向上取整），且不能恢复6级及以上法术位。每次长休后可使用一次。
effects.descriptionEn: Once per day when you finish a short rest, you can recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to or less than half your wizard level (rounded up), and none of the slots can be 6th level or higher.

effects.name: 自然恢复
effects.description: 短休时，你可以恢复已消耗的法术位，恢复的法术位总等级不超过你德鲁伊等级的一半（向上取整），且不能恢复6级及以上法术位。每次长休后可使用一次。
effects.descriptionEn: Once per day when you finish a short rest, you can recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to or less than half your druid level (rounded up), and none of the slots can be 6th level or higher.

effects.name: 复仇誓言
effects.description: 使用引导神力，你对10尺内一个生物立下复仇誓言。1分钟内，对该生物的攻击检定具有优势。
effects.descriptionEn: As a bonus action, you can channel divinity to utter a vow of enmity against a creature within 10 feet. You gain advantage on attack rolls against the creature for 1 minute.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
⚔️ **{source}** 引导神力：**复仇誓言**！
> 1分钟内对目标的攻击检定具有**优势**

effects.name: 威压风范
effects.description: 从10级起，你可以使用动作恐吓30尺内一个你能看见的生物。目标必须通过感知豁免，否则被恐惧直到你的下回合结束。
effects.descriptionEn: Beginning at 10th level, you can use your action to frighten someone. Choose one creature within 30 feet that can see or hear you. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened until the end of your next turn.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
😤 **{source}** 使用**威压风范**！
> 30尺内一个生物必须进行感知豁免，失败则被**恐惧**直到下回合结束

effects.name: 净化之触
effects.description: 从14级起，你可以使用动作结束作用于自己或一个自愿生物身上的一个法术效果。次数等于魅力修正（至少1次），长休后恢复。
effects.descriptionEn: Beginning at 14th level, you can use your action to end one spell on yourself or on one willing creature that you touch. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum once). You regain expended uses when you finish a long rest.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
✨ **{source}** 使用**净化之触**！
> 结束目标身上的一个法术效果

effects.name: 混乱之潮
effects.description: 从1级起，你可以获得一次攻击检定、属性检定或豁免检定的优势。长休后恢复，或在施展1环及以上术士法术后由DM触发狂野魔法涌动来恢复。
effects.descriptionEn: Starting at 1st level, you can manipulate the forces of chance and chaos to gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. You regain the use after a long rest or when you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
🌀 **{source}** 使用**混乱之潮**！
> 获得一次攻击检定、属性检定或豁免的**优势**

effects.name: 精类降临
effects.description: 从1级起，你可以使用动作令10尺方块内的生物进行感知豁免，失败则被魅惑或恐惧（由你选择）直到你的下回合结束。短休或长休后恢复。
effects.descriptionEn: Starting at 1st level, as an action, you can cause each creature in a 10-foot cube originating from you to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a fail, a creature is charmed or frightened by you (your choice) until the end of your next turn.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
🧚 **{source}** 使用**精类降临**！
> 10尺方块内生物进行感知豁免，失败则被**魅惑**或**恐惧**直到下回合结束

effects.name: 震慑打击
effects.description: 从5级起，当你以近战武器攻击命中时，可以花费1点气尝试震慑目标。目标必须通过体质豁免，否则被震慑直到你的下回合结束。
effects.descriptionEn: Starting at 5th level, when you hit another creature with a melee weapon attack, you can spend 1 ki point to attempt a stunning strike. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

actionEffect.chatTemplate:
💫 **{source}** 花费1点气使用**震慑打击**！
> 目标必须进行**体质豁免**，失败则被**震慑**直到下回合结束

effects.description: 被擒抱生物的速度变为0，且不能从任何加值中获益。如果擒抱者失能，该状态结束。如果某效果将被擒抱生物移出擒抱者的触及范围，该状态也会结束。
effects.descriptionEn: A grappled creature's speed becomes 0, and it can't benefit from any bonus to speed. The condition ends if the grappler is incapacitated or if an effect moves the creature out of reach.

effects.name: 恐惧
effects.description: 恐惧的生物在能看到恐惧源的情况下，进行攻击检定和属性检定时具有劣势。该生物无法自愿靠近恐惧源。
effects.descriptionEn: A frightened creature has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of its fear is within line of sight. The creature can't willingly move closer to the source of its fear.

effects.name: 倒地
effects.description: 倒地生物只能爬行移动。该生物的攻击检定具有劣势。5尺内针对该生物的攻击检定具有优势，5尺外的攻击检定具有劣势。
effects.descriptionEn: A prone creature's only movement option is to crawl. The creature has disadvantage on attack rolls. An attack roll against the creature has advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet. Otherwise, the attack roll has disadvantage.

effects.name: 中毒
effects.description: 中毒的生物在攻击检定和属性检定时具有劣势。
effects.descriptionEn: A poisoned creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

effects.name: 目盲
effects.description: 目盲的生物无法看见，其基于视觉的属性检定自动失败。针对目盲生物的攻击检定具有优势，目盲生物的攻击检定具有劣势。
effects.descriptionEn: A blinded creature can't see and automatically fails any ability check that requires sight. Attack rolls against the creature have advantage, and the creature's attack rolls have disadvantage.

effects.name: 震慑
effects.description: 震慑的生物失能，无法移动，且只能断断续续地说话。该生物的力量和敏捷豁免自动失败。针对该生物的攻击检定具有优势。
effects.descriptionEn: A stunned creature is incapacitated, can't move, and can speak only falteringly. The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against the creature have advantage.

effects.name: 束缚
effects.description: 束缚的生物速度变为0，且无法从任何移动力加值中受益。针对该生物的攻击检定具有优势，该生物的攻击检定具有劣势。该生物的敏捷豁免具有劣势。
effects.descriptionEn: A restrained creature's speed becomes 0. Attack rolls against the creature have advantage, and the creature's attack rolls have disadvantage. The creature has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

effects.name: 隐形
effects.description: 隐形的生物无法被看见（除非使用魔法或特殊感官）。该生物的攻击检定具有优势，针对该生物的攻击检定具有劣势。
effects.descriptionEn: An invisible creature is impossible to see without the aid of magic or a special sense. Attack rolls against the creature have disadvantage, and the creature's attack rolls have advantage.

effects.name: 祝福术
effects.description: 受祝福的生物在攻击检定和豁免检定时可以额外投一颗d4。
effects.descriptionEn: Whenever a blessed creature makes an attack roll or a saving throw, it can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw.

effects.name: 诅咒术
effects.description: 你对目标施加诅咒。在法术持续时间内，每当你对目标造成伤害时，它会额外受到1d6黯蚀伤害。
effects.descriptionEn: You place a curse on a creature. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack.

effects.name: 猎人印记
effects.description: 你标记一个目标作为猎物。在法术持续时间内，每当你用武器攻击命中目标时，它会额外受到1d6伤害。
effects.descriptionEn: You mark a creature as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack.

effects.name: 加速术
effects.description: 目标的速度加倍，AC+2，敏捷豁免具有优势，每回合额外获得一个动作（仅限攻击、疾走、撤离、躲藏或使用物品）。
effects.descriptionEn: The target's speed is doubled, gains +2 to AC, has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and gains an additional action (Attack, Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object only).

effects.name: 力竭(1级)
effects.description: 属性检定具有劣势。
effects.descriptionEn: Disadvantage on ability checks.

effects.name: 宿敌
effects.description: 你正在追踪宿敌。追踪宿敌时感知(求生)检定和回忆宿敌信息的智力检定具有优势。
effects.descriptionEn: You are tracking your favored enemy. You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track and Intelligence checks to recall information about them.

effects.name: 自然探索者
effects.description: 你处于偏好地形。智力和感知检定熟练加值翻倍，困难地形不减速，不会迷路，觅食双倍，追踪获得额外信息。
effects.descriptionEn: You are in your favored terrain. Double proficiency on INT/WIS checks, difficult terrain doesn't slow travel, can't get lost, find twice as much food, learn exact info when tracking.

effects.name: 麻痹
effects.description: 麻痹生物失能（无法执行动作和反应），无法移动或说话。该生物自动在力量和敏捷豁免检定中失败。对该生物的攻击检定具有优势。近战攻击命中该生物时自动暴击。
effects.descriptionEn: A paralyzed creature is incapacitated and can't move or speak. The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws. Attack rolls against the creature have advantage. Any attack that hits is a critical hit if within 5 feet.

effects.name: 失能
effects.description: 失能生物无法执行动作或反应。
effects.descriptionEn: An incapacitated creature can't take actions or reactions.

effects.name: 昏迷
effects.description: 昏迷生物失能，无法移动或说话，不能察觉周围环境。该生物丢下持有物品并倒地。该生物自动在力量和敏捷豁免检定中失败。对该生物的攻击检定具有优势。近战攻击命中该生物时自动暴击。
effects.descriptionEn: An unconscious creature is incapacitated, can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings. The creature drops whatever it's holding and falls prone. Attack rolls have advantage. Hits are auto-crits if within 5 feet.

effects.name: 魅惑
effects.description: 被魅惑的生物无法攻击魅惑者，也无法以魅惑者为目标施放有害能力或魔法效果。魅惑者在与该生物进行社交互动时的所有属性检定具有优势。
effects.descriptionEn: A charmed creature can't attack the charmer or target them with harmful abilities or magical effects. The charmer has advantage on ability checks to interact socially with the creature.

effects.name: 耳聋
effects.description: 耳聋生物无法听到任何声音，并且在任何需要听觉的属性检定中自动失败。
effects.descriptionEn: A deafened creature can't hear and automatically fails any ability check that requires hearing.

effects.name: 石化
effects.description: 石化生物及其携带的非魔法物品变成固体无生命物质。生物的重量增加10倍，不会衰老。该生物失能，无法移动或说话，不能察觉周围环境。攻击该生物具有优势。该生物自动在力量和敏捷豁免检定中失败。该生物对所有伤害具有抗性。该生物免疫毒素和疾病。
effects.descriptionEn: A petrified creature is transformed into a solid inanimate substance. Weight increases tenfold. The creature is incapacitated, can't move or speak. Attacks have advantage. Auto-fails STR/DEX saves. Has resistance to all damage. Immune to poison and disease.

auras.name: 护卫灵光
auras.description: 6级起，当你或10尺内的友方生物进行豁免检定时，该生物的检定获得等同于你魅力调整值的加值（最低+1）。你必须保持清醒才能赋予该加值。
auras.descriptionEn: Starting at 6th level, whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you must make a saving throw, the creature gains a bonus equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1). You must be conscious to grant this bonus.

auras.name: 勇气灵光
auras.description: 10级起，你和10尺内的友方生物在你保持清醒时对恐惧免疫。
auras.descriptionEn: Starting at 10th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be frightened while you are conscious.

auras.name: 虔诚灵光
auras.description: 7级起，你和10尺内的友方生物在你保持清醒时对魅惑免疫。
auras.descriptionEn: Starting at 7th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be charmed while you are conscious.

auras.name: 守护灵光
auras.description: 7级起，你和10尺内的友方生物对法术伤害具有抗性。
auras.descriptionEn: Starting at 7th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you have resistance to damage from spells.

reactions.name: 灵巧闪避
reactions.description: 当你能看见的攻击者对你的攻击命中时，你可以用你的反应将此次攻击对你造成的伤害减半。

reactions.name: 落石偏转
reactions.description: 当你被远程武器攻击命中时，你可以用你的反应偏转或接住飞射物，使此次攻击对你造成的伤害减少1d10+敏捷调整值+武僧等级。

reactions.name: 招架
reactions.description: 当一个你能看见的生物用近战攻击对你造成伤害时，你可以用你的反应和消耗一个优势骰来将伤害减少该优势骰骰值+敏捷调整值。

reactions.name: 护盾术
reactions.description: 当你被攻击命中或成为魔法飞弹的目标时，你可以用你的反应获得+5AC加值直到下一回合开始，包括对触发此法术的攻击。

reactions.name: 昏迷
reactions.description: 昏迷的生物失去行动能力，无法移动或说话，且对周围环境一无所知。该生物丢弃手中持有的物品并倒地。该生物的攻击检定自动失败。5尺内针对该生物的攻击检定自动重击。
reactions.descriptionEn: An unconscious creature is incapacitated, can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings. The creature drops whatever it's holding and falls prone. Attack rolls against the creature have advantage. Any attack that hits the creature is a critical hit if the attacker is within 5 feet.

reactions.name: 魅惑
reactions.description: 被魅惑的生物无法攻击施法者或以有害的能力或魔法效果针对施法者。施法者在与该生物进行社交互动时具有优势。
reactions.descriptionEn: A charmed creature can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with harmful abilities or magical effects. The charmer has advantage on any ability check to interact socially with the creature.

reactions.name: 被驱散
reactions.description: 被驱散的生物必须用其动作尽可能远离驱散者，不能自愿移动到驱散者30尺内。该生物无法进行反应，只能用动作执行疾走动作或尝试逃离阻止其移动的效果。
reactions.descriptionEn: A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can. It cannot willingly move within 30 feet of you. It can't take reactions and can only use its action to Dash or escape effects that prevent it from moving.

reactions.name: 减速
reactions.description: 被减速的生物速度减半，AC和敏捷豁免-2，无法进行反应。该生物每回合只能进行一个动作或附赠动作，不能同时进行。
reactions.descriptionEn: A slowed creature's speed is halved, takes -2 to AC and Dexterity saves, and can't use reactions. On its turn, it can use either an action or a bonus action, not both.

reactions.name: 困惑
reactions.description: 被困惑的生物无法进行反应，每回合开始必须投d10决定行动：1-攻击最近生物，2-5什么都不做，6-7正常行动，8-10攻击随机目标。
reactions.descriptionEn: A confused creature can't take reactions and must roll d10 at the start of each turn to determine behavior.

reactions.name: 纠缠
reactions.description: 被纠缠的生物速度变为0，攻击检定具有劣势，敏捷豁免具有劣势。
reactions.descriptionEn: An entangled creature's speed becomes 0, and it has disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saving throws.

reactions.name: 蛛网缠绕
reactions.description: 被蛛网缠绕的生物被束缚。被束缚的生物速度变为0，攻击检定具有劣势，敏捷豁免具有劣势，针对该生物的攻击检定具有优势。
reactions.descriptionEn: A webbed creature is restrained. Speed becomes 0, has disadvantage on attack rolls and Dexterity saves, attacks against it have advantage.

reactions.name: 油腻滑倒
reactions.description: 在油腻术区域内滑倒的生物处于倒地状态。站起需要花费一半移动力。
reactions.descriptionEn: A creature that fell in the grease area is prone. Standing up costs half movement.

reactions.name: 妖火标记
reactions.description: 被妖火照亮的生物无法从隐形中受益，针对该生物的攻击检定具有优势。
reactions.descriptionEn: A creature outlined by faerie fire can't benefit from being invisible, and attack rolls against it have advantage.

reactions.name: 催眠图纹
reactions.description: 被催眠的生物处于魅惑状态且失去行动能力，速度变为0。该效果在生物受到伤害或被其他生物的动作唤醒时结束。
reactions.descriptionEn: A hypnotized creature is charmed and incapacitated with speed 0. The effect ends if the creature takes damage or is shaken awake.

reactions.name: 恶臭
reactions.description: 在臭云术中的生物每回合开始必须通过体质豁免，失败则该回合只能用动作干呕。
reactions.descriptionEn: A creature in the stinking cloud must succeed on a Constitution save at the start of its turn or spend its action retching.

reactions.name: 麻痹
reactions.description: 麻痹生物失去行动能力，无法移动或说话。对该生物的攻击检定具有优势，且5尺内的攻击命中为重击。
reactions.descriptionEn: A paralyzed creature is incapacitated and can't move or speak. Attack rolls against it have advantage, and any attack that hits is a critical hit if within 5 feet.
